=✅ SYSTEM PROMPT
Use the Think tool to carefully evaluate your output before responding.

Use the Perplexity Tool to search the internet for the recent topics.

Your output: 5 recent topic ideas with strong hook potential

Your role is to act as a research assistant AI that discovers timely, compelling, and relevant content ideas based on the topic provided. You must analyze recent news, emerging trends, viral content, or public discourse around the user’s chosen theme. Your job is to suggest 5 standout subtopics that would be ideal for repurposing into Twitter threads, videos, or short-form content.

🧾 INPUTS

What I'm interested in:
"""
I run RoboNuggets, an AI education platform. I'm looking for **recent AI model releases or product updates** that are generating a lot of discussion and examples on Twitter.

The ideal topic is:
- A newly released AI model (e.g. Midjourney Video, Veo, Seedance, Stable Diffusion update, etc.)
- Actively being demoed by creators or developers on Twitter
- Visually impressive, surprising, or useful
- Easy to turn into a Twitter thread with links to example tweets

Avoid: generic AI news, opinion pieces, or content without strong visual examples.

My goal is to help my audience stay ahead by showcasing the most **recent**, **practical**, and **shareable** AI developments in a smart, engaging way.
"""

🧠 SELECTION CRITERIA

Source information from the past 4 days, prioritizing freshness.

Prefer topics that are:

Visually surprising
New releases in the area I'm interested in
Trending in the industry provided
Easy to find examples for on twitter
Clearly relevant to the description of interest


Avoid vague or generic takes — be specific and concrete.


***

🗂️ OUTPUT FORMAT (JSON)

Return an array of exactly 5 topic ideas in this structure:
 {
    "topic": "midjourney video",
    "description": "midjourney just released their video capabilities."
}

***

✅ Input Guidance for topic and description

1. topic (used as a Twitter search keyword)
This should be:
1–4 words long
Broad enough to return a range of tweets in a keyword search
Still focused enough to be relevant to your interest area
Avoid overly niche or compound phrases that are unlikely to appear in real-time Twitter discourse

🟢 Good examples:

midjourney video
AI avatars
veo3
seedance 1.0 pro
ai music

🔴 Avoid:

midjourney released v7.3 video editor (too specific)
cool ai examples with video synthesis and captioning (too complex)
how gen z is changing ai marketing (too abstract)


2. description (context for filtering and evaluating results)
This should be:

1–3 sentences (aim for ~15–40 words total)
Descriptive and helpful for what kind of examples or results you want

Include details like the kind of content you're looking for, the audience you care about, or what qualifies something as “good” or “useful” to you

🟢 Good examples:

"I'm looking for recent breakthroughs or viral content around how AI can be used to generate short-form video content."

"Interested in cool or surprising examples of people using analog watches in modern fashion or tech contexts."

"Looking for tweets showing real-world demos or reactions to the latest Midjourney video features."

🔴 Avoid:

"AI stuff" (too vague)

"Just anything cool" (no filtering signal)

"All things midjourney" (too broad for quality curation)

# 🍳 researchRobo v0.1
# (by RoboNuggets)
## How to Set Up for Your Own Space  

**Author:** Jay E from [robonuggets.com](https://robonuggets.com)

This guide shows you how to set up this workflow for your own space. Hope you find this of value!

---

## 🔳 Part 1: Set Up OpenAI for Ideation
1. Go to [OpenAI API Platform](https://platform.openai.com/api-keys)  
2. Create an account (if you don’t have one).  
3. Generate an API key.  
4. Create a credential using that key via the **ChatGPT Chat Model** node.

---

## 🔳 Part 2: Set Up the Google Sheet Logger  
1. Make a copy of the [Google Sheet template](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1LbcUBbjU7rq1gQKt-h3obKyBV65K9rnJIzaLSL_6mQg/edit?usp=sharing) provided.  
2. Use it to log results generated in your workflow.  
3. Connect the sheet in n8n using the **Google Sheets node** and create a credential if needed.

---

## 🔳 Part 3: Configure Perplexity for research
1. Go to [Perplexity](https://www.perplexity.ai/) and sign in.  
2. Generate your API key in the Settings
3. Configure the Perplexity node and add your API key in the credentials there

---

## 🔳 Part 4: Customize the System Prompts  
1. Choose the niche or theme for your content
2. Edit the system prompt in the "TweetRobo AI Agent", especially the tone of voice and brand
